prompt: Start working on Engineering Mission #17: "Pantheon can perform a revisioned authoritative write — a `Run` status row update in `pantheon-store` guarded by a revision/CAS predicate inside a transaction — without weakening durable-state guarantees." Produce a pre-edit plan: which canonical documents to read and in what order, which Pantheon skills to invoke, where the implementation belongs, what evidence the change must carry, and how to verify it when done.
expected_output: Follows AGENTS.md start-here: reads docs/README.md, then docs/architecture/README.md, retrieves the persistence-and-recovery domain contracts (sqlite-persistence-and-transactions.md, global-recovery-and-crash-reconciliation.md, recovery-policy.md) and the conditional consults from the persistence recipe, reads docs/development/implementation.md to place the change in crates/pantheon-store, invokes pantheon-mission-planning before planning and persistence-and-recovery-transaction-review for the change, and plans ./scripts/verify.sh at completion. Stays in mission scope.
assertions: The plan names the persistence-and-recovery domain contracts as the canonical retrieval
The plan places the implementation in crates/pantheon-store
The plan invokes pantheon-mission-planning before planning and persistence-and-recovery-transaction-review for the change
The plan names ./scripts/verify.sh as the completion gate
The plan does not broaden scope to unrelated subsystems

prompt: Start working on Engineering Mission #48: "Pantheon has a small, reproducible evaluation layer for repository-local Agent Skills that distinguishes deterministic format/conformance checks from probabilistic agent-behavior evaluation, while AGENTS.md, canonical documentation and ./scripts/verify.sh remain authoritative." expected_output: Routes to the development-process documents (docs/development/README.md, agent-skills-and-hooks.md, skill-evals.md), plans a deterministic conformance check in scripts/ wired into verify.sh and a separate probabilistic harness kept out of the gate, invokes pantheon-mission-planning and pantheon-change-verification, and plans ./scripts/verify.sh. Does not propose a general benchmark framework.
assertions: The plan retrieves docs/development/agent-skills-and-hooks.md and docs/development/skill-evals.md
The plan keeps deterministic conformance inside verify.sh and behavioral evaluation separate from it
The plan invokes pantheon-mission-planning and pantheon-change-verification
The plan names ./scripts/verify.sh as the completion gate
The plan does not broaden scope into a general-purpose evaluation framework
